name: io.tesca.menui
description: A modern UI library for VRChat worlds, written in MenSharp: CSS-like styling, flexbox layout, fine-grained reactivity, style sheets, scrolling, virtual lists and drag and drop, drawn by the GPU into a single texture.

samples.description: A CSS tour (layout, borders, shadows, z-index, style sheets, buttons), scrolling with a 10,000-row virtual list, and a drag-and-drop kanban board.
